work.title: Warplane Formation with Discs 2
work.description: Multiple top-down warplane silhouettes rendered in black outline float across a pale ground layered with vertical red and yellow paint stripes. Compact discs with concentric ring patterns occupy the lower left, while looping magenta and grey gestural marks fill the remaining field.
work.composition: multiple warplanes scattered across pale ground
